J1.name: lineage
J1.instructions: The state describes one defect found in a software project. Which {dimension} from the options does this defect belong to? Choose none when the defect concerns no listed {dimension}, and new-key when it clearly concerns a {dimension} that is not listed.

extra.new-key: the defect clearly concerns a {dimension} that is not listed

J2.name: foundational
J2.instructions: The state holds one finding, the rows it names, and the results resting on the same code or on it. The finding shows that a reference, an oracle, a comparison arm, or an assumption that those other results depend on is wrong in the regime where they use it.

criteria.true: the finding shows a reference, oracle or premise other results depend on is wrong in the regime they use it in
criteria.false: the finding is a defect or measurement that does not undercut what other results depend on

J7.name: trigger form
J7.instructions: The state is the reopen trigger of a parked issue. What kind of trigger is it?

criteria.regime-observable: a measurable quantity of the operating regime crossing a stated threshold, with where it is observed
criteria.downstream-symptom: a later failure or symptom appearing elsewhere, not a quantity of the regime itself
criteria.not-objective: no observable or no threshold that someone other than its author could check

J10.name: park watch
J10.instructions: Does the result in `result` report on {observable}? A report can be a measurement, a count, or an observation, including that it did not happen.

J11.name: duplicate
J11.instructions: The state holds one new finding (`finding`) and earlier records. Which earlier record already describes the same defect, or the same idea already tested and rejected, so that the new finding adds nothing new? Choose none when no earlier record does; a related record with a different mechanism or a different setting is not the same.

extra.none: no earlier record describes the same defect or the same rejected idea
